story.text: Prescribed Medications. These are medications that a healthcare professional has advised you to take, including vitamins and supplements available over-the-counter.

story.label: Glucor (Metformin) 10mg Tablet
story.directions: Take 1 tablet by mouth once in the morning
story.not_prescribed: Don't feel like taking this medication because it makes me sick.

story.label: Aspirin 10mg Tablet
story.directions: Take 1 tablet by mouth once in the morning

story.label: Combs 20mg Tablet (Coreg)
story.directions: Take 1 capsule by mouth twice a day
story.use: To replace potassium that lasix removes

story.label: Lasix 40mg Tablet (Furosemide)
story.directions: Take 1 tablet by mouth twice a day
story.use: Water pill to control water weight and prevent stress on heart

story.label: Acupril 40mg Tablet (Quinapril)
story.directions: Take 1 tablet by mouth daily as needed
story.use: To help my high blood pressure
